source.author: hor
source.text: Olim truncus eram ficulnus, inutile lignum, cum faber, incertus scamnum faceretne Priapum, maluit esse Deum.
source.text_original: Olim truncus eram ficulnus, inutile lignum,  / cum faber, incertus scamnum faceretne Priapum, / maluit esse Deum.
source.text_english: Once I was a figwood stump, useless timber, when a craftsman, uncertain whether he should make a bench or a Priapus, chose that it should be a god.
